'''Mare Tino (VSC) Our Most Virtual Hour''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mare Tino]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HB Tino LS 2002 VSCOurMo.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

OMDH deck which uses 5/6 of the virtual cards.

== Strategy ==

Here's my attempt at using at making a good LS deck with 6 [V] cards.

Setup at Tatooine and 1 or 2 docking bays. Then Menace Fades an Celebration. Then drain and retrieve.

Most important card to grab is : Masterful Move or Masterful Move & Endor Occupation.

If your opponent deploys Do They Have A Code Clearance, wait with completing OMDH. You can deploy it, but complete it only when it is vital.

I wanted to pack Order To Engage and/or Beggar to draw Shields, but I just don't have any room for it.

To Play with all [V] cards:

ADD

- Han' Heavy Blaster Pistol

- General Solo

- Gold Squadron 1

- Endor

- Strike Planning

DITCH

- Captain Han Solo

- Millenium Falcon

- Dagobah

- Dagobah: Yoda's Hut

- Yoda

Start with Strike Planning or Sai'torr Kal Fas [V]

Martijn Peeters
